answer: To deter Sybil attacks, the network binds each agent identity to a topological vertex whose validation rights demand non-refundable cryptographic stake burning. Operating through physical and computational friction—metaphorically smelting raw copper into burnt hash capital—every sequential identity in an attacker’s voyage incurs a superlinear cost scaling as O(N^2). This explosive economic burn makes sustaining coordinated fake nodes mathematically ruinous.
